subject: Temporary SLO exception request — overnight P2 response coverage (Acme Analytics)
messages:
From: Tom Riley <tom.riley@acmeanalytics.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: contracts@acmeanalytics.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 08:12:00 -0500
Subject: Request: temporary overnight SLO adjustment for P2 responses

Hi Olga,

We have a scheduled rollout of our internal batch-processing pipeline over the next three weeks that will increase overnight traffic and false-positive alerts. Our ops team is asking whether Redwood can provide a temporary adjustment to P2 response expectations between 00:00-06:00 EST. Specifically, we're requesting that P2 response windows be extended from 4 hours to 8 hours for the duration of the maintenance window (2026-01-20 through 2026-02-10).

This is a short-term ask — we want to avoid unnecessary paging for low-impact incidents while the pipeline stabilizes. We understand this is an exception and are happy to sign an addendum or accept a credit schedule if needed.

Can you advise on feasibility and the required approvals?

Thanks,
Tom Riley
Director, Site Reliability
Acme Analytics

[Attachment: maintenance_plan_q1_2026.pdf (PDF)]

From: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
To: Tom Riley <tom.riley@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 09:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary overnight SLO adjustment for P2 responses

Tom — thanks for the note and the maintenance plan. Short answer: we can consider a temporary SLO exception but will need a concrete on-call coverage and escalation plan from Support/Engineers, plus a signed amendment that limits the exception window and rollback criteria.

Default Redwood SLOs we use for reference:
- P1: initial response within 1 hour (24/7)
- P2: initial response within 4 hours (business hours + limited overnight coverage)

Proposed next steps from our side:
1) Support/On-call to propose how overnight alerts will be triaged and when paging will still happen.
2) Legal/procurement to prepare a short addendum for 2026-01-20 to 2026-02-10.
3) Confirm whether you want a credit schedule for missed P1/P2 guarantees during the window.

I've looped in Priyom (support on-call manager) and Marcus (engineering lead) to draft the coverage plan. Once we have that, Laura in our contracts team will prepare the amendment.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai

From: priyom.das@redwood.ai
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai, Tom Riley <tom.riley@acmeanalytics.com>
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 11:30:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary overnight SLO adjustment for P2 responses

Hi all — quick operational take from Support. We can implement a constrained exception but need to be explicit about what triggers paging vs. what is considered triage work:

- Proposal for 2026-01-20 -> 2026-02-10 (00:00–06:00 EST):
  * P1 (system-wide outage / data-loss) => full page to 24/7 rotation (no change).
  * P2 (partial degradation / increased error rate) => first-line triage handled by on-call L1 with an 8-hour initial response window overnight; pages escalated immediately if customer reports persistent data loss or any SLA-significant degradation.
  * Any automated runbook must include a severity check: if error rate > 5% for more than 15 minutes, escalate to engineering L2.

- On-call coverage: we can staff a reduced L1 overnight rotation (one engineer), with L2 escalation to Marcus (or his delegate) during the 00:00–06:00 window. Marcus has confirmed availability for critical escalations but requests paged items be filtered by the triage rules above.

- Runbook draft attached: oncall_runbook_draft.md

We should also add a rollback clause: if this causes more than two unintended P1 pages in a rolling 7-day period, the exception is revoked and normal SLOs resume.

—Priyom
Support On-call Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Tom Riley <tom.riley@acmeanalytics.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@acmeanalytics.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 16:00:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary overnight SLO adjustment for P2 responses

Thanks, Priyom — that triage definition looks reasonable. A few clarifications from our side:

- We absolutely want immediate paging for anything meeting P1 criteria.
- The rollback clause you suggested is fine.
- We will also want the amendment to include explicit logging/notifications that note when the exception window is in effect (so our on-call knows not to assume full daytime SLOs).

Procurement, can you prepare for the addendum sign-off and let us know if a credit or prorated adjustment is required?

Tom

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: Tom Riley <tom.riley@acmeanalytics.com>, olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: contracts@acmeanalytics.com
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 18:22:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary overnight SLO adjustment for P2 responses

Hi Tom — Laura from Contracts. Thanks for the heads-up. We can do a 3-week addendum (2026-01-20 through 2026-02-10) that:

- Documents the adjusted P2 initial response window (8 hours overnight 00:00–06:00 EST) and explicit P1 carve-outs.
- Includes the rollback clause (>=2 P1 pages in a rolling 7-day period).
- Adds a requirement for runbook + escalation matrix (we'll reference the oncall_runbook_draft).

Next steps for signatures: I'll generate a short addendum and send via DocuSign. Please confirm payor and whether Acme expects a credit for reduced coverage. If credit is requested, please provide a contact and we will route to Finance.

Attaching preliminary amendment link: https://docusign.com/AMENDMENT/ACME-2026-SLO-42

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Contracts Manager
Redwood Inference

[Attachment: amendment_docusign_link.txt]

From: olga.petrov@redwood.ai
To: Tom Riley <tom.riley@acmeanalytics.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai, marcus.lin@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 09:00:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Request: temporary overnight SLO adjustment for P2 responses — summary and next steps

Summary and action items:

- Agreement: Redwood will apply a temporary SLO exception for P2 initial response to 8 hours between 00:00–06:00 EST from 2026-01-20 through 2026-02-10. P1 commitments remain at 1 hour and are paged 24/7.
- Operational guardrails: oncall_runbook_draft.md will be finalized by Priyom and Marcus by 2026-01-18. The runbook will include the severity filter, paging rules, and the rollback trigger (>=2 P1 pages in 7 days).
- Legal/Procurement: Laura to issue DocuSign amendment (link above). Acme procurement to confirm credit request by EOD 2026-01-18 if desired.
- Monitoring: Marcus to add an automated alert that flags when the exception window is active and when automatic rollbacks are triggered. Provide the alert link to Acme ops.

I'll keep the thread open for edits. If there are no objections, Laura will send the amendment for signature tomorrow and Priyom will circulate the final runbook.

Thanks everyone — Olga
Account Lead, Redwood Inference
